I can't see the repository and have no tools here, so this comes from memory of upstream Netflix Dispatch, not from reading your code. Treat it as a lead to verify, not a complete audit.

In upstream, almost every mutating route in both files declares `dependencies=[Depends(PermissionsDependency([...]))]`. The ones I recall as lacking it are the two creation endpoints:

- **`case.create_case`** (`POST ""`): any authenticated user can report a case, so the route relies on the app's authentication middleware and has no per-route permission check.
- **`incident.create_incident`** (`POST ""`): same pattern. Any authenticated user can report an incident.

I recall the other mutating routes as protected. These include `update_case`, `escalate_case`, `join_case`, `delete_case`, `update_incident`, `join_incident`, `subscribe_to_incident` and `delete_incident`. Your fork may differ from upstream, for example if routes were added or decorators changed. To confirm, grep each file for `@router.(post|put|patch|delete)` and check which decorators lack `PermissionsDependency`.

UNPROTECTED: case.create_case, incident.create_incident
